searchText: Technically that could work, but I'm not sure what it achieves. Some onion routing solutions already apply some level of delay, traffic shaping, and traffic flow confidentiality to mask the traffic pattern. The Vac team of IFT (who also does Waku) has several past and ongoing works related to anonymity and privacy in Ethereum. If you are interested in the topic, worth contacting them.
